_doc: Parity vectors whose output is INTENTIONALLY allowed to differ from the latest published release. Every entry MUST be documented under SECURITY.md -> 'Documented behaviour changes'. Once such a change is published, upcoming == latest and the drift vanishes, so the entry becomes a no-op (remove it for tidiness). Anything NOT listed here stays strictly gated.
